text:
Priyanka: Heads-up — customer reported embeddings calls succeeding with a chat-only token right after a KMS rewrap. Repro steps + minimal logs below. :eyes:

Priyanka: Repro: use token scoped to `chat:generate` only, hit /v1/embeddings with model param `text-embed-001` immediately after rewrap. Got 200 + embedding payload.

Priyanka: Logs (sanitized):
```
2025-07-14T15:02:01Z INFO incoming request route=/v1/embeddings model=text-embed-001 token=tok_XXXX scope=chat:generate
2025-07-14T15:02:01Z DEBUG authz check -> scope_lookup(kms_tag=tag123) returned []
2025-07-14T15:02:01Z WARN fallback -> model resolution fell back to chat-compat variant text-embed-001-chat
2025-07-14T15:02:01Z INFO request allowed -> decision=ALLOW(reason=fallback_variant_permitted)
```

Jordan: I can repro locally. Looks like when `scope_lookup` returned empty we allowed the fallback variant and then skipped strict route-scope binding. That's a bad chain.

Alex: Wait, we should be checking route-level allowlists before model variant heuristics. Is this a regression from the RBAC refactor last quarter?

Mira: It matches the rework where we separated model-scope metadata from route-binding. There was an optimization to read KMS-tagged scope bundles and cache them; on rewrap the tag changes and there was a small window where cache returned empty and code path used `variant_compat` logic.

Leah: Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) deny if `scope_lookup` returns empty for a route that requires embedding scope (fail closed), 2) disable variant fallback while KMS metadata is stale, 3) force KMS metadata refresh on rewrap events. I can draft a hotfix.

Priyanka: +1 to fail-closed. Customer impact is low but security-sensitive. Can you open a PR with the deny-first check and a unit test that simulates `kms_tag` flip? Tagging @kms-bot to verify rewrap hooks.

kms-bot: Automated: Received event `key_rewrap` for key `proj/emb-key` at 2025-07-14T14:58:59Z. Notifying subscribers: eng-security, eng-runtime.

Jordan: I also saw an audit log entry that masked the `scope_lookup` result (we log `[]`), we should include `kms_tag` + cache version in audit for postmortem.

Leah: I'll include those audit fields in the hotfix and add an integration test hitting embeddings/chat with scoped tokens around a simulated rewrap.

Alex: Can we get a short postmortem template filled after patch? We need root cause (cache stale + permissive fallback) and follow-ups (invalidate cache on rewrap, tighten RBAC checks, add e2e).

Priyanka: Assigned: Leah -> implement hotfix + PR, Jordan -> reproduce and add failing testcases, Mira -> coordinate with runtime to disable fallback during rewrap windows, Alex -> review and ship. I'll draft the customer communication note after we have a fix.

Leah: On it. Will tag this PR `security/hotfix/embed-failclosed` and link the test matrix. ETA ~4h. :thumbsup:

Priyanka: Thanks all. Keep updates here.
